module: Event node "On Vehicle Switched" (category `logic`, tag event). Emits a pulse on `flow` when the player changes vehicle (hook `onVehicleSwitched`). Outputs: `oldID`, `newID` (number) and `player` (hidden).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_afterTrigger.desc: Called by the manager after the node is triggered; resets the event flag to false.

_executionStarted.desc: Called by the manager when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the internal state to zero.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the player changes vehicle; `oid` old id, `nid` new id, `player` player id.

work.desc: If a change was signaled, fills `oldID`, `newID`, `player` and sets `flow` to true for one frame.
